title: Recognize when a canonical one-seed representation cannot discover the dynamics
statement: If div f=0 then q=0,T1=0, so the canonical one-seed cyclic route has rank one regardless of nontrivial integrable dynamics. The exact quartic oscillator q_prime=p,p_prime=-q^3 is the supplied example. A first integral, guessed Lax pair or another known conjugate does not supply a general raw-equation full-state decoder. The broader invariant-fibration/integrability acquisition operation remains a research target.
